story.title: Clear completed tasks
acceptanceCriteria: With some tasks completed, the footer shows a "Clear completed" action.
Clear completed removes only the completed tasks; active tasks stay in the list.
The items-left counter is unchanged by clearing.

scenes.title: Clear completed appears
scenes.narration: Criterion one. Our list has three tasks, and one of them is done. Because a task is completed, the footer shows a Clear completed action.

scenes.title: Only completed tasks are removed
scenes.narration: Criterion two. We click Clear completed. The finished task disappears, and the two active tasks stay in the list.

scenes.title: The counter is unchanged
scenes.narration: Criterion three. The items left counter still reads two, the same as before we cleared.
